scripts.build: npm run build --workspace sanity-studio && npm run build --workspace portfolio-web
scripts.test:all: npm run lint && npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:studio && npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:component && npm run test:coverage && TEST_SKIP_BUILD=1 npm run test:e2e && TEST_SKIP_BUILD=1 npm run test:accessibility && TEST_SKIP_BUILD=1 npm run test:quality && TEST_SKIP_BUILD=1 npm run test:lighthouse
scripts.schema:extract: npm exec --workspace sanity-studio -- sanity schema extract --path schema.json --force
scripts.typegen: npm run schema:extract && npm exec --workspace sanity-studio -- sanity typegen generate
